info.description:
PreClass AI backend: teachers import sources, AI drafts a Worksheet/Flashcards, the system links every block to its source and flags problems, the teacher approves block by block and publishes an immutable snapshot; students answer first, then see the approved explanation.

**Contract status: v0 (draft) — frozen as v1.0.0 on 16/11 morning.** After the freeze fields are only added.

**Conventions**
- Base path `/v1`. JSON is camelCase. Ids are UUIDs. Times are ISO-8601 with offset.
- Auth: server-side session cookie `preclass_session` (HttpOnly). Use `credentials: "include"` and send header `X-PreClass-CSRF: 1` on every non-GET request (missing → 403 `CSRF`). Same origin in production (Caddy); in dev use Next.js `rewrites` to `/v1`.
- Errors: RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`. Wrong role → 403 `FORBIDDEN_ROLE`; someone else's resource (or another class) → 404.
- Edits carry `version` (optimistic lock) → 409 `VERSION_CONFLICT`. Approvals carry `contentHash` → 409 `STALE_REVIEW`.
- Lists are `{items, nextCursor}`; `nextCursor` is always null in v1.
- All routes are implemented; Prism (`openapi/openapi.json`) is only for frontend work without a running API.
info.title: PreClass AI API

post.summary: Create a source from a DOCX file (TEACHER, multipart)

post.description: Accepts DOCX, PDF, XLSX, PPTX; the type is read from the file's magic bytes, the client's name and Content-Type are ignored. Limits: 10 MB; ≤ 1000 zip entries, ≤ 20 MB unzipped; ≤ 50 PDF pages, ≤ 5 sheets × 2000 cells, ≤ 60 slides (env `SOURCE_*`). Rejected with 422: `FILE_TOO_LARGE`, `SOURCE_TOO_LARGE`, `INVALID_FILE`, `MACRO_REJECTED`, `EXTERNAL_CONTENT_REJECTED`, `ACTIVE_CONTENT_REJECTED` (PDF JavaScript/attachments), `PARSE_TIMEOUT` (30 s), `EMPTY_SOURCE`. A PDF without a text layer returns 201 with `extractStatus=FAILED`, `extractError=SCANNED_PDF` (no OCR). Anchor locators: PDF `{page, para}`, XLSX `{sheet, row, col, header?}` (0-based row/col, stored values only, formulas are never evaluated), PPTX `{slide, shape, para}` or `{slide, shape, row, col}`.
